answerable: Long-term mean annual bottom-boundary drainage flux (QDRAI/QDRAI_XS) from ELM as a proxy for potential deep recharge
Relative controls of soil texture vs. meteorological forcing on simulated recharge flux
Elevation-gradient variation of net infiltration surplus (P - ET - runoff) across the Naches
Quasi-steady recharge via a long spin-up until storage/flux terms stabilize
not_answerable: The 'true' steady-state recharge validated against direct measurements (no recharge observations exist)

Actual flux reaching a deep regional water table, since single-column ELM lacks lateral groundwater flow and deep saturated-zone dynamics (needs PFLOTRAN coupling for the deep unsaturated/saturated column)
Spatially continuous recharge across the full basin (site archetype = discrete columns, not a distributed grid)

parsed.n_justification: The Naches spans a large elevation range (352-1977 m) with strong orographic precipitation gradients and varied soils. Four columns sample the low-elevation valley, mid-slope, and high-elevation zones plus a coarse-vs-fine soil contrast, enabling attribution of recharge to forcing (elevation/precip) vs. soil texture while keeping the site-archetype tractable.
requires_capabilities: Long accelerated-decomposition + final spin-up (>=200 yr looping 1980-2018 forcing) to reach quasi-steady hydrologic storage
ELM variable water-table / groundwater (WA, ZWT) hydrology enabled
PFLOTRAN coupling for deep unsaturated-zone transport to a true deep water table (recharge lag/attenuation)
Bias-corrected downscaled meteorological forcing capturing orographic precipitation gradient
Soil texture data (e.g., SSURGO/POLARIS) for column-specific parameterization
assumptions: ELM bottom-boundary drainage (QDRAI/QRECHARGE) is treated as a proxy for potential deep recharge, not validated flux
Vertical 1-D flow dominates; lateral groundwater redistribution is neglected in single-column mode
'Steady-state' is interpreted as multi-decadal mean under quasi-equilibrium spin-up, not true hydrostatic equilibrium
1980-2018 forcing is representative of long-term climate for recharge estimation
USGS well WTD and Fan 2013 priors are used to initialize/constrain ZWT, not to validate recharge directly
